title: Waiting for Wings
author: Lois Ehlert

hero.name: butterfly
hero.description: Brightly coloured butterfly as depicted on the cover of Waiting for Wings — bold, graphic Lois Ehlert art style with vivid wing patterns
hero.source_note: Generic butterfly symbol available in Boardmaker; choose a colourful, wings-spread image to match Ehlert's bold style

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the action of flying (verb) or a fly insect (noun)
ambiguous.reason: In this book butterflies fly — the verb meaning is primary; students will use it to describe butterfly movement

ambiguous.issue: Could mean to grow a plant or a creature growing/changing size
ambiguous.reason: In this book both caterpillars and plants grow — the general growth/change meaning is correct; search 'grow plant' or 'growing' for a clear picturable symbol

notes: This book traces the complete butterfly life cycle (egg → caterpillar → chrysalis → butterfly) alongside garden plant vocabulary. Eight of the twelve fringe words already exist in activity_images or aac_extras (egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly, flower, nectar, garden, leaf, milkweed, fly) — only 'wings' and 'grow' will need new icons sourced. The hero butterfly is well-covered by generic Boardmaker symbols; select the most colourful, wings-spread option available to match Ehlert's vivid illustrations. 'Chrysalis' may be labelled 'cocoon' in some symbol libraries — flag this for the teacher, as Ehlert uses 'chrysalis' specifically. 'Milkweed' is unlikely to exist in standard Boardmaker libraries; a photo or custom clip art image may be needed. The fixed core already covers 'see', 'more', 'where', and 'finished', which are useful for this book's repetitive predictable text pattern.
